title: Capstone 1: Game Leaderboard Filter
subtitle: Data Pipeline Filtering
description: Build high-score filters across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
scores = [120, 45, 85, 30, 95]
threshold = 50
# Stage 1: Filter high scores >= threshold

challenges.title: Stage 1: High Score Filter
challenges.description: Collect all scores from <hlt>scores</hlt> that are <hlt>>= 50</hlt> into <hlt>high_scores</hlt>. Print <hlt>high_scores</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
scores = [120, 45, 85, 30, 95]
threshold = 50
high_scores = []
# Stage 1: Filter scores >= 50
for s in scores:
    if s >= threshold:
        high_scores.append(s)
print(high_scores)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Top Scorer Discovery
challenges.description: Find the maximum score among the filtered scores and print it.
challenges.starter_code:
high_scores = [120, 85, 95]
# Stage 2: Find maximum score
top = high_scores[0]
for s in high_scores:
    if s > top:
        top = s
print(top)
